name: Mario
description: The well-rounded plumber. Great for beginners with balanced speed, power, and recovery.

name: Link
description: The Hero of Hyrule wields the Master Sword and a variety of projectiles.

name: Pikachu
description: A fast and agile electric Pokémon with excellent recovery and combo potential.

name: Little Mac
description: The hardest-hitting boxer in the game with the strongest ground game. Poor in the air but devastating on the ground.

name: Min Min
description: ARMS fighter with long-range extending arm attacks. Unique playstyle with left-stick for left arm, A for right arm.

name: Donkey Kong
description: A powerful heavyweight with great range and combo potential. High damage output but slow movement.
